messages:
anya: Quick ping — opened PR #4823 to onboard model 'praxis-7b' and apply a tiny tokenizer padding tweak + quant profile change. Can someone take a quick look before the merge window? Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4823

Changes: short checklist in the PR body — model config, tokenizer padding, sparse quant profile. Minimal weight updates, no schema migration.

sam: On it, will skim tokenizer diff and perf numbers.

leon: I can eyeball the model config. Quick question: did you bump kv_cache settings or is it unchanged?

anya: kv_cache unchanged. main changes are:
```yaml
model: praxis-7b
quant_profile: sparse-8
tokenizer:
  pad_side: right
  pad_token: <pad>
```
(the PR has the full diff)

maya: If sampler tests are failing I'll add a small unit to cover padding edge cases — can push to the branch?

anya: yes please, branch open to collaborators.

sam: Found one tiny nit — tokenizer.pad_side is explicit right now, good for latency, but add a comment explaining why (padding on right keeps prefix cache hits consistent). Other than that, looks fine.

leon: Config-wise LGTM, except follow: can you set max_seq_len to 4096 in the model profile? workload tests expect it.

anya: updated PR w/ max_seq_len=4096 and a note in the changelog.

devops-bot: CI re-run requested by @sam — build 4823.2 queued.

sam: also reran unit tests locally, saw one flaky on windows containers (timeout). opened a follow-up pinned to the PR — not blocking merge.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: scheduled merge window today 17:00 UTC if CI passes. If you need an earlier emergency merge ping @eng-platform #oncall.

anya: Can we hold for a short staging smoke run after CI? I want 1 hour observation on staging latency/throughput. Prefer to merge only after that — not urgent but conservative.

jorge: I'll run the smoke now on staging and report back.

jorge: smoke run complete — basic convo scenario + long context tests passed. latency within expected bounds, no mem spike. :tada:

leon: Nice — rebase and ping me, I'll give formal approval once green.

maya: pushed a tiny unit test for tokenizer padding edge case.

sam: left one inline nit about wording in the changelog, non-blocking.

anya: rebased, addressed comments, force-pushed.

leon: Approved. :+1:

deploy-bot: Merge queued for window 2024-11-05T17:00:00Z — PR #4823 will merge if no regressions detected.

anya: Thanks all! Will monitor post-merge and post a short incident note if anything odd shows up.
